user.title: Wake Word Recorder
user.description: Folder of the household (with household.yaml). Takes are saved to its data/real folder.

create.title: Create household.yaml
create.description: There is no household.yaml in {path} yet. Choose who will record wake words and mark the children (they need more takes). Then add the words to household.yaml (see the README).

error.duplicate_people: Two people would get the same id - rename one of the person entities.

abort.already_configured: Wake Word Recorder is already set up.

start_session.name: Start recording
start_session.description: The satellite asks for each take of the word and records it, no wake word needed. Defaults to the choices of the select entities.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: Voice satellite that records (e.g. Home Assistant Voice PE).

count.name: Count
count.description: Takes to record now (default: until the person's target).

stop_session.name: Stop recording
stop_session.description: Ends the session and switches the satellite back to its pipeline.

reload.name: Reload household
reload.description: Reads household.yaml again (new people or words).

start_background.name: Record background
start_background.description: The satellite records the sounds of the home (TV, talking, kitchen) for the given time, without speaking. Nobody should say the wake word meanwhile. Saved to data/background.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: Voice satellite that records (default: the chosen one).
